parsed.rationale: The second participating record in `Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift` carries `is_sample_app: true`, which is a restraint marker that dominates any action signal. Per the decision rules, a mixed cluster where one record is a production type (`DebugPanel` package, `is_sample_app: false`) and another is a sample-app file is the canonical restraint pattern. Lifting the production `DebugMetricsProvider` from `Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift` into shared code would couple production semantics to the sample-app demonstration fixture in `WallpaperSampleApp`. The only structural difference between the two (`metalDevice:MTLDevice?` vs `metalDevice:(any MTLDevice)?`) is a minor existential-syntax variation consistent with the sample app being written or updated independently, not evidence of a deliberate generic abstraction opportunity.
